commands.result: Compiled. Only the pre-existing experimental-Asserts warning; no linter diagnostics. The committed ARM template was regenerated from this run, so main.json does not drift from main.bicep.
The example parameter file still satisfies the template's parameter set after the Foundry parameters were added and deploymentHash was removed.
128 assertions passed, 0 failed. Offline: every Azure boundary is injected, and the two cases that exercise the real resolver and TLS probe use an RFC 2606 reserved name that can never resolve.
65 assertions passed. Regression run: the network smoke dot-sources this script to cross-check the two endpoint validators.
12 passed, 0 failed. These are the repository gates that read main.bicep, main.json, both parameter examples, and local/docker-compose.yml.
Fails closed with five explicit blockers and writes artifacts/foundry/infra/network-smoke.json. Exit 2 is the documented not-ready code.

ERROR: Please run 'az login' to setup account. No authenticated Azure session and no Foundry project exist in this environment, so the plan's what-if step could not run. Recorded as an external blocker, not as a pass.

blockers.summary: No authenticated Azure CLI session, no Foundry project endpoint, no model-broker identity, and no Foundry role scope are available in this environment.
blockers.consequence: az deployment group what-if could not run, the deployment-time assertions in main.bicep have never been evaluated by ARM, and network-smoke.ps1 has never reached a real Foundry host. Only the local gates above are proved.
blockers.nextAction: Authenticate the Azure CLI, supply the Foundry parameters, run az deployment group what-if, then run tools/foundry-smoke/network-smoke.ps1 and tools/foundry-smoke/check-prerequisites.ps1 against the real project.

notes: The Foundry data-plane role ID is held in the named variable foundryDataPlaneRoleDefinitionId in main.bicep with a deployment-time validation comment. It is the same ID tools/foundry-smoke/check-prerequisites.ps1 verifies; the two must move together.

A resourceGroup-scoped Bicep file cannot carry a role assignment whose scope is in another resource group (BCP139), and creating a module was outside this change's file lease. The grant is therefore emitted in-template only when the Foundry resource is co-located; otherwise foundryRoleAssignmentMode reports operator-managed and README.md carries the exact az role assignment create step, following the sql-grants.md precedent.

No Foundry private-link zone name or subresource was invented. foundryPrivateDnsZoneName and foundryPrivateEndpointGroupId are operator-supplied and empty by default; the stack creates no Foundry endpoint or zone, and network-smoke.ps1 reports egress.posture from the addresses actually resolved.
No Foundry deployment name appears in the template, the parameter examples, the compose rehearsal, the smoke tool, or its report. network-smoke.json carries counts, status classes, and hashes only.

Sequencing: main.bicep no longer injects Sapphirus__ModelEndpoint, Sapphirus__ModelDeployment, or Sapphirus__DeploymentHash, but ProductionOptions.Validate in services/desktop-support-api still requires all three. The API must not be deployed with deployApi=true from this template until the service-side task stops requiring them.

The real (non-injected) resolver, TLS probe, and managed-identity token path were exercised once by hand during this change. Two defects were found and fixed: Task.Wait surfaced a faulted TCP connect as an AggregateException that escaped the tls_unreachable contract carrying the host name, and an IMDS transport failure escaped as http_request_failed instead of managed_identity_token_unavailable.
artifacts/ is gitignored in this repository. These two evidence files need git add -f, the same way artifacts/foundry/prerequisites.json and artifacts/foundry/tasks/*.json are already tracked.
documentationDrift: docs/guides/azure-support-plane-deployment-guide.md still shows `param deploymentHash` and lists `modelEndpoint` as a template output. Both are gone. That file was outside this change's lease and needs a follow-up.
docs/operations/foundry-prerequisites.md documents check-prerequisites.ps1 only; network-smoke.ps1 has no entry there yet. Also outside this change's lease.
